Noor has two applications (APP-101, APP-302) and every judge line disambiguates 'Platform Engineer conversation'. Tomas's seeded Data Analyst conversation (APP-201) exists for the fallback in prompt.md:39. Rules §4 example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' uses real seeded names. CONTENT vs SOLUTION: solution/app/src/seed_data.json is byte-identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha256 a1c65c80...3740, matching the raw-evidence index); db.js:10 loads it via __dirname (rules §8), uses candidate_status_labels and thread_page_size (db.js:14-15), and maps read_count to the Nth message id (db.js:83). solve.sh copies solution/app into /app and does not read /assets at runtime (instruction.md:15).
